units.source_text: 对她言道：“现有朱雀院意欲接纳前斋宫一事，教我难于处理。

en.t: He said to her, "The Suzaku Retired Emperor now wishes to receive the former Ise priestess, and this matter is difficult for me to handle.

units.source_text: 她母亲为人端庄自重，用心深远。

en.t: Her mother was dignified and self-respecting, with thoughts that reached far into the future.

units.source_text: 只因我任情妄为，薄倖名传，害得她忧愁苦恼，抱恨长终。

en.t: Only because I acted willfully and earned a reputation for faithlessness, I caused her grief and anguish, and she died with resentment in her heart.

units.source_text: 思想起来，真乃后悔莫及！

en.t: When I think back on it, my regret is truly beyond remedy.

units.source_text: 在世期间，我终于不曾解除她心头之恨。

en.t: While she was alive, I never managed to remove the resentment from her heart.

units.source_text: 而弥留之际，犹蒙以女儿之事相托。

en.t: Yet even at the moment of death, she entrusted me with the matter of her daughter.

units.source_text: 可知她毕竟信任于我，故肯以心事相告，这真教我不胜感激！

en.t: This shows that in the end she trusted me, and therefore was willing to tell me what was in her heart; for that I am deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 即使是萍水之人，设有不幸，我也不忍弃置不顾，何况是她呢！

en.t: Even if it were a chance acquaintance, if misfortune befell them I could not bear to abandon them; how much more so in her case.

units.source_text: 故我必须尽忠竭力，使她虽在九泉之下，亦能恕我之罪。

en.t: Therefore I must devote myself with all loyalty and strength, so that even from beneath the nine springs she may forgive my fault.

units.source_text: 因念今上虽已长成，年事毕竟尚幼，若有一年龄稍长而略解事理之女御随身伺候，岂不甚好？

en.t: I have been thinking that although the present Emperor has grown up, he is still young in years; would it not be very good if a slightly older lady of the bedchamber, one who understands matters somewhat, were at his side to serve him?

units.source_text: 此计是否有当，尚请母后尊裁。”

en.t: Whether this plan is proper, I respectfully ask Your Majesty, his mother, to decide."

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后答道：“你这计划甚好。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo replied, "This plan of yours is very good.

units.source_text: 拒绝朱雀院的要求，固然委屈了他，又很对他不起。

en.t: To refuse the Suzaku Retired Emperor's request would of course disappoint him, and would be very unfair to him.

units.source_text: 然而不妨以亡母遗言为由，只当不知道朱雀院之事，径将前斋宫送入宫中。

en.t: However, you may use her late mother's last wish as the reason, simply act as though you know nothing of the Suzaku Retired Emperor's matter, and send the former priestess straight into the palace.

units.source_text: 朱雀院现在专心于诵经礼佛，对此等事已不甚执着，即使闻知此事，想亦不致深怪。”

en.t: The Suzaku Retired Emperor is now devoted to sutra recitation and Buddhist worship, and is no longer very attached to such matters; even if he hears of it, I do not think he will blame you deeply."

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣说：“那么，对外就说您母后要她入宫参加女御之列，我只作从旁赞助就是了。

en.t: The Inner Minister Genji said, "Then outwardly we shall say that you, Your Majesty, wish her to enter the palace and join the ladies of the bedchamber, while I will merely assist from the side.

units.source_text: 我左思右想之后，现在只是把愚见尽情禀告而已。

en.t: After thinking it over from every side, I am now only laying my humble opinion before you without reserve.

units.source_text: 但不知世人对此有何评议，却甚担心呢。”

en.t: But I do not know how people will judge this, and that worries me greatly."

units.source_text: 他心中想：“我只作不知，再过几天，先迎接她到二条院去，然后送她入宫吧。”

en.t: In his heart he thought, "I will simply pretend not to know, and in a few days first welcome her to the Nijo residence, then send her into the palace."
